resources.string: Start NetWatch with --agent on your home server or PC. It prints a link like https://192.168.1.10:8765/?token=… and a SHA-256 fingerprint. Paste the whole link here.
This doesn\'t look like an agent link. It must start with https:// and contain ?token=
Could not reach the agent: %1$s\n\nAre you on the same network as the agent?
The agent refused the token. Copy the link again from the agent\'s output (or data/agent-token).

The agent presented this certificate:

%1$s

Does it match the SHA-256 fingerprint the agent printed when it started? If it doesn't, someone may be intercepting the connection.
The agent\'s certificate changed. The connection was blocked. If you regenerated the certificate, choose “Change agent”.
Serious alerts from your NetWatch agent, checked every 15 minutes while you are on the same network
